about.headline: Your scent is your identity

2002.title: 2002 — Where it began
2002.body: We started in Al Ataba with retail, then supplied shops across Cairo.

import.title: Direct import
import.body: We grew to import straight from the fragrance houses, which earned us Khadlaj's official agency in Egypt.

2020.title: 2020 — Our official showroom
2020.body: Opened during the pandemic, keeping our customers’ trust through every difficulty.

2025.title: 2025 — The widest range
2025.body: We expanded the showroom to carry the broadest collection of scents for every taste.

about.agency: Al Haramain is the exclusive agent in Egypt for Khadlaj and Nabeel, and an authorized distributor for houses such as Lattafa, Afnan and Assaf, so you buy 100% authentic at a fair price.

authentic.title: 100% authentic
authentic.body: Every product comes through official agency and distribution.

prices.title: Fair prices
prices.body: Direct agency means real value, not inflated retail markups.

delivery.title: Fast delivery
delivery.body: Quick, reliable shipping across Egypt, right to your door.

experts.title: Curated by experts
experts.body: 23 years of expertise behind every fragrance we carry.
